paragraphs.text: Paq is an aetherborn who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where they have a bounty outstanding.

Paq is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction . An aetherborn with the typical blue-glowing body, ashen at the edge where they are slowly disintegrating, they stand out in their Slickshot Gang attire. They wear elaborate frilled and fan-shaped coats and collars, characteristic of the Slickshots' fashionable style. Paq was last seen fleeing across the rooftops of Thunder Junction, a dazzling display of acrobatic skill as they carried away a stash of stolen jewels and a valuable vase. Paq’s ability to cover their tracks and leave little evidence behind makes them a difficult target to capture. Their reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by their ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on their back.
